question: Which type of reaction is involved in the rusting of iron?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Redox**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rusting of iron** is a chemical process where iron reacts with oxygen and moisture to form **iron oxides**, commonly called rust.
 
• This reaction involves both **oxidation** and **reduction**, hence it is categorized as a **redox reaction**.
 
• The **oxidation process** involves the loss of electrons by iron (Fe) as it forms ferrous (Fe²⁺) or ferric (Fe³⁺) ions.
 
• The **reduction process** involves oxygen being reduced by gaining electrons to form hydroxide ions (OH⁻) in the presence of water.
 
• The overall reaction can be written as:

 **4Fe + 3O₂ + 6H₂O → 4Fe(OH)₃**, which eventually dehydrates to form rust (Fe₂O₃·xH₂O).
 
• **Moisture and oxygen** are crucial for the rusting process, which is why it occurs more rapidly in humid environments.
 
• The formation of rust weakens the iron structure, causing damage to its strength and durability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Displacement Reaction**__

 __
 
• A displacement reaction occurs when a more reactive element displaces a less reactive element from its compound. For example, **Zn + CuSO₄ → ZnSO₄ + Cu**.
 
• Rusting is not a displacement reaction as no exchange or replacement of elements occurs during the process.
 
 
 
• **Combination Reaction**__
 __
 
• In a combination reaction, two or more substances combine to form a single product. For example, **2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O**.
 
• Rusting is not a combination reaction because multiple reactions occur simultaneously, and it is not limited to just combining reactants into one product.
 
 
 
• **Decomposition Reaction**__
 
 
• A decomposition reaction involves the breakdown of a compound into two or more substances. For example, **CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂**.
 
• Rusting is not a decomposition reaction, as it involves the formation of new compounds (iron oxides) rather than breaking down existing compounds.
